method: Complete relevant functions inspected manually read-only; no native probe, compilation, execution or source copy.
conclusions: HighlightChanged passes keyboard-only first preselection when its timer argument is absent; reopening the already active child returns without resetting its highlight.
Popup ImplExecute always enables GrabFocus; StartPopupMode grabs popup window focus independently of item selection.
Run preselects first item only when requested; new popup starts with invalid highlighted item.
ImplCursorUpDown from invalid highlight goes to first on Down and last on Up; Home/End select their boundaries.
KEY_RETURN with no enabled selected item calls StopExecute without ImplSelect; nested PopupEnd calls parent ClosePopup, which kills current child only.
Floating ImplEndPopupMode passes focus to the retained parent popup; browser parent trigger focus is the existing item-based focus adaptation.
Existing Writer Text/Rulers composition is preserved; native mouse delay, disabled traversal defaults, full mnemonics and broad lifetime remain separate unverified obligations.
